steps.speaker: Report
steps.content: "The items brought back have been individually checked. In addition to household items, a black cloth was found, on which excess Mania residue was detected. This has been submitted to the FAC for further research."

steps.speaker: Report
steps.content: "The team also found a wolf tooth necklace, well-preserved. Fingerprints thereon matched Sinner S-076's. It is suspected to be the Sinner's property and has been left to the Chief to handle..."
This investigation finds almost nothing. While brooding over Mania weapons, you hear a rustling noise from the pile of documents.
Chk chk chk! Chk chk chk!
A black and white furball peeks out of the pile of documents on your desk.
Chk chk chk!!!
The furball angrily raises its head. It's Wolverine's pet, Pippy.
Aren't you Pippy who's always on Wolverine's shoulder? What are you doing here?

steps.speaker: Pippy
steps.content: Chk!
Seeing that you recognize him, Pippy climbs on top of your files and points to the picture of Wolverine, tugging your sleeve.
Wolverine? What's wrong with him?
Pippy keeps trying to pull you outward with all his might.
Pippy nods and gestures. You fail to understand.
It seems you should follow Pippy to see what's happening. And... you have something to give Wolverine anyway.
You follow Pippy into the yard, where Wolverine is sitting alone on top of a wall, facing the Rust.
Pippy nimbly climbs up the wall and sits back onto his master's shoulder, reporting that he has finished his task.

options: What are you doing up there?

choices.text: What are you doing up there?

steps.content: He points to his nose without answering your question.

steps.speaker: Wolverine
steps.content: Everything alright here?
Labiche is fine. He seemed pretty happy once we paid out compensation.

steps.speaker: Wolverine
steps.content: Tsk, who cares about that bastard... I'm asking about your nose! I hit you in the interrogation room.

steps.speaker: Wolverine
steps.content: Tsk, idiot... I'm asking about your nose! I hit you in the interrogation room.
I had almost forgotten about it until you said something. That was just a little tap. I recovered ages ago.

steps.speaker: Wolverine
steps.content: Oh... Well, I'm sorry.
Wolverine pouts absentmindedly and won't look directly at you.

steps.speaker: Wolverine
steps.content: Also... I'm sorry I lost control, and didn't respect our agreement.
Wolverine is apologizing but still looks arrogant. He doesn't lower his head and keeps looking toward the Rust.
Now that you know it was wrong, don't do it again.

steps.speaker: Wolverine
steps.content:
That's all?
...You're as strange as he was.

steps.speaker: Wolverine
steps.content: No matter what happened, with those two little words—I'm sorry—he would forgive everything.
You don't look like knowing why what you did was wrong.

steps.speaker: Wolverine
steps.content: I. Am. Sorry.

steps.speaker: Wolverine
steps.content: Aren't those the magic words? You're just as picky as him.
"Him"? You mean Hank? Is that why you only listened to me in the interrogation room, because I'm like him?

steps.speaker: Wolverine
steps.content: Who said I listen to you? You just have those same stinky habits the way he did... What's there to be proud of?

steps.speaker: Hank
steps.content: Hey, kid! Why aren't you wearing any clothes? Where are your mommy and daddy?

steps.speaker: Hank
steps.content: Are you going around on all fours? No way, you look like a wild baby... Ow! You bit me!

steps.speaker: Little Wolverine
steps.content: Grr—

steps.speaker: Hank
steps.content: If it's meat you want, I'll cook some! Relax!
Hank escapes with some struggles. He turns away and pulls a piece of meat protected by layers of newspapers from his pile of trash. Then he puts it onto a hot stone until the fat begins to sizzle.

steps.speaker: Hank
steps.content: Ah ah ah, this meat is a good thing. You don't see many people like me anymore, who will repay evil with kindness. Now, what do you say about biting me just now?

steps.speaker: Little Wolverine
steps.content: ...Awoo?

steps.speaker: Hank
steps.content: I forgot you're a feral child. You can't speak. Okay, repeat after me: I'm sorry, gramp, you're a good man, I shouldn't have bitten you.

steps.speaker: Hank
steps.content: That's a little long, huh? Ok, try this one: I'm. Sorry.

steps.speaker: Little Wolverine
steps.content: Aye. Sawi...

steps.speaker: Hank
steps.content: I. Am. Sorry.

steps.speaker: Little Wolverine
steps.content: Aye. Sawi?

steps.speaker: Hank
steps.content: ...Alright, I'll forgive you for now. We still have a long time to learn!

steps.speaker: Little Wolverine
steps.content: Aye! Sawi!

steps.speaker: Hank
steps.content: Okay, okay, eat your meat!

steps.speaker: Wolverine
steps.content: Heh...
You hear the young man on the wall make a soft, happy noise, but you have never heard Wolverine laugh, except for sneers.

steps.speaker: Wolverine
steps.content: Me?
You and Pippy both nod.

steps.speaker: Wolverine
steps.content: Oh, maybe... I was thinking back to when I was little.
That was Pippy laughing. It definitely wasn't you!

steps.speaker: Wolverine
steps.content: You've got to get your ears checked...
So it was you?

steps.speaker: Wolverine
steps.content: What, can't I laugh? I was just... thinking back to when I was little.

steps.speaker: Wolverine
steps.content: I was trained by the gang for too long, and then I lived alone for a while—there's a lot I've forgotten.

steps.speaker: Wolverine
steps.content: But since I met you, I've recalled some of it.

steps.speaker: Tramp
steps.content: Hahaha, look, everyone! The old bastard's brought a young bastard, and they're playing house!
The tramp throws a stone at Wolverine from far away.

steps.speaker: Tramp
steps.content: Hey, little freak, beg me and I'll give you and the old man some meat!
Little Wolverine bares his teeth. It looks like he's about to jump on the tramp and rip out his throat.

steps.speaker: Hank
steps.content: Wolverine, stop!

steps.speaker: Little Wolverine
steps.content: Die!

steps.speaker: Hank
steps.content: It's not a big deal, we'll find meat on our own. Ignore him!

steps.speaker: Tramp
steps.content: You can talk! You've fed the pup your winter stores. What food do you have left? You gonna eat trash? Hahaha.

steps.speaker: Little Wolverine
steps.content: Kill!

steps.speaker: Hank
steps.content: Every day with the shouting "beat" and "kill." Is the animal name making you a real animal?

steps.speaker: Hank
steps.content: Do you remember what gramp said to you? What makes you different from the animals is—

steps.speaker: Hank
steps.content: It's in one ear and out the other—Don't be impulsive! Impulses are the devil!

steps.speaker: Tramp
steps.content: Yo, do you even know how to spell "impulsive"? What a load!

steps.speaker: Hank
steps.content: The hell business is it of yours? When Wolverine grows up, he'll learn and teach it to me!

steps.speaker: Wolverine
steps.content: Hey, Ch— you!
Up on the wall, Wolverine whirls around to face you.

steps.speaker: Wolverine
steps.content: Do you know how to spell "impulsive"?
Of course. Do you want to learn to read and write?

steps.speaker: Wolverine
steps.content: I don't want to learn anything else, just that one word, "impulsive."
While you're still trying to figure out what Wolverine means, a black shadow springs from behind you—

steps.speaker: Demolia
steps.content: Hey, Chief!!
The girl's voice is loud, and you're completely startled.
Demolia? When did you get here?

steps.speaker: Demolia
steps.content: Just now, but shouldn't Wolferine have noticed me, sitting up that high?

steps.speaker: Wolverine
steps.content: It's Wol-VER-ine!
Wolverine crosses his arms and turns around, unhappy at being interrupted.

steps.speaker: Demolia
steps.content: What are you doing sitting on a wall? Oh, I know, you like pondering the meaning of life, like me. Life is like scavenging in trash...
Demolia! Why are you here?

steps.speaker: Demolia
steps.content: I almost forgot! I was looking for you to come drinking, Chief! A lot of people are waiting for you! Let's go!
Demolia pulls you to leave the yard. Wolverine acts like he didn't hear, keeping his back turned and not showing any intention to stop you.
Wolverine, do you want to come with us?

steps.speaker: Demolia
steps.content: Hey, that's a great idea! He's never joined us in anything before!

steps.speaker: Wolverine
steps.content: No, I don't know them.
Don't you want to learn how to write? If you come, I'll teach you how to write "impulsive."

steps.speaker: Wolverine
steps.content: Tsk. I'll ask someone else.
There's a lot of good food at a party!
Pippy starts to salivate, but Wolverine still doesn't move.
Time to play the trump card.
So you are afraid?
After all, it's easy to lose control when you're drunk. Then, learning to write "impulsive" and even copying it out a hundred times wouldn't change anything.

steps.speaker: Wolverine
steps.content: Nothing that makes you lose control can be a good thing! I'm definitely not going!
He's clearly eager, but won't stop being stubborn.
Time to play the trump card.
test

test
test
test
test
test
When they were collecting Hank's things, they found a wolf tooth necklace. I don't know if it's—
Wolverine jumps down from the wall before you can finish.

steps.speaker: Wolverine
steps.content: I'll go.

steps.speaker: Demolia
steps.content: Hooray!
Wolverine takes the box from your hands and opens it before he's even come to a stop. A wolf tooth necklace lies within. The crude tooth is a little yellow and strung on a leather cord.
When Hecate was checking through the scene, she found a clue to the Mania weapon trade and this necklace.

options: It seemed like you were looking for this.

choices.text: It seemed like you were looking for this.

steps.speaker: Wolverine
steps.content: ...Yes.
The person who found it said it was hidden in a box and taken care of very well. It was important, right?

steps.speaker: Wolverine
steps.content: The old bastard gave it to me. When I realized he was selling me to the gang, I threw it away.
Wolverine blows the dust off the wolf tooth.

steps.speaker: Wolverine
steps.content: I don't know where he got it back...

steps.speaker: Little Wolverine
steps.content: Hank, what are you doing?

steps.speaker: Hank
steps.content: Hehe, I'm making you a present. Look, do you like it?

steps.speaker: Little Wolverine
steps.content: Don't want a present. I want meat.

steps.speaker: Hank
steps.content: A year ago today was the day I found you. It might as well be your birthday. You should have a heartfelt gift better than meat.

steps.speaker: Little Wolverine
steps.content: You mean you couldn't get any meat.

steps.speaker: Hank
steps.content: You little jerk. I'll sell you before I let us starve to death!

steps.speaker: Little Wolverine
steps.content: No.

steps.speaker: Hank
steps.content: What do you mean no? If you go with someone else, you'll be able to eat as much as you want. I wish I had someone to sell me!

steps.speaker: Little Wolverine
steps.content: No!

steps.speaker: Hank
steps.content: Hahaha, I'm kidding. What are you angry about? I don't know how you got so petty... Anyway, do you want the necklace or not?

steps.speaker: Little Wolverine
steps.content: Yes!
Wolverine looks at the necklace in his hands, distracted.
What was Hank—the man who most wanted to see Wolverine become a human being—thinking when he found this necklace, after learning that the gang had turned Wolverine into their war dog?
Did Hank regret at that moment?
You may never know.

steps.speaker: Demolia
steps.content: What are you waiting for? Hurry, hurry! They'll drink it all before we get there!
Let's go, Wolverine!
Wolverine collects the necklace and follows behind you towards people and places unknown.

steps.speaker: Wolverine
steps.content: Okay, I'm coming.
